call_n = 1
executed_waypoints = []

def state():
    return np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'], dtype=float)

def show_state():
    print('time_left', obs.meta.get('time_left_s'), 'pose', state()[8:15].round(4).tolist(), 'gripper', state()[15])

def ee(points, name, video='mp4'):
    """Submit [x,y,z] or [x,y,z,gripper] rows, retaining current tool rotation."""
    global obs, call_n
    if isinstance(points[0], (float, int, np.floating)):
        points = [points]
    q = state()[11:15]
    rows=[]
    for p in points:
        p=list(p)
        g=float(p[3]) if len(p)>3 else float(state()[15])
        rows.append([*map(float,p[:3]), *map(float,q), g])
    res = r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(rows, dtype=np.float32), video=video, note=name)
    call_n += 1
    res.save(str(OUT / f'{call_n:03d}_{name}'))
    print('RESULT', name, json.dumps(res.meta, indent=2), flush=True)
    executed_waypoints.extend({'name':name,'pose':row} for row in rows)
    obs = r.get_obs(video='none')

    call_n+=1; res.save(str(OUT/f'{call_n:03d}_{name}'))
    print('WATCH',name,json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2),flush=True)
    obs=res; show_state(); return res

def save_record():
